title: Install an app in Windows Edge
label: Windows · Edge · Install app

compatibility.note: Based on current vendor instructions. No device screenshots or tested OS/browser versions are available; version coverage is unconfirmed.

evidence.note: Original schematic artwork illustrates the documented controls, not an exact device capture.

steps.title: Open Settings and more
steps.description: Open the website in Microsoft Edge. Click the three horizontal dots at the top-right of the browser.

steps.title: Choose More tools
steps.description: Choose More tools from the menu.

steps.title: Choose Install this site as an app
steps.uiLabel: Install this site as an app
steps.description: Choose Install this site as an app. For an installable PWA, Edge may instead offer Install app or an install icon in the address bar.

intro: The menu route follows Microsoft’s current Edge help. Other Edge versions may place Apps directly in Settings and more. Documentation draft: not yet verified on a device; menu layout and confirmation prompts may vary.

completion.description: To reopen it, enter edge://apps and click Open on the app’s card. Details offers Pin to taskbar, Pin to Start and Create Desktop shortcut.
